scope: 2023 MUST_ENTER races only; exhaustive 210 fixed support-rank 2-point formations

method.rank_definition: Rank riders 1-7 by current-race marginal support S, descending; ties by rider number.
method.formation_definition: Choose a fixed pair of support ranks as the 2-rider core and exactly two other support ranks as third riders. Two 3連複 tickets, 100 yen each, every MUST_ENTER race.
method.odds_phase: final; historical diagnostic, not T-10 executable odds

warning: Best formation is selected in-sample on 2023 and must be frozen before forward validation.
